title: test(plugin-security): split the three-officer posture cases one per auditor variant

Fixes #35436

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；只拆分了一组权限测试，断言一条不少、含义不变。
- 为什么做：这组测试在 CI 负载高时会撞到单条测试 5 秒的默认上限，跟改动无关却让别的修复一直是红的。
- 出错会怎样：只动测试，不动产品代码；撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

## 席位核对

### What changes
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`, the three-officer describe. The 12 cases (2 postures × 6 callers) each looped over the 3 auditor variants. They become 36 cases (2 postures × 6 callers × 3 variants). Each case does one variant's grant insert, removal by id, bulk removal and position holding, then removes every row it wrote, with the same `finally` as before. Every `expect` line is unchanged. The only code that moved is the `for (const variant ...)` loop, lifted from inside the `it` to around it.
- The file's `test-budget:` header line keeps its number (20) and its class. Its REASON now says 128 cases, thirty-six of them three-officer cases, and why they were split.
- No global `testTimeout` raise, no per-case timeout, no skip, nothing deleted.
- Two-minute check: run this one file. You should see 128 green, with each three-officer case under 0.25 s locally.

### Tests
These were run locally on one shared 4-core box under `os-verify-lock.sh`. Absolute seconds are shared-box readings; the ratios are the claim. Head `3de047739a`:

| | before (BASE `a9b36efffa`) | after (`3de047739a`) |
|---|---|---|
| file | 104 passed, tests phase 20.94 s | 128 passed, tests phase 22.27 s |
| three-officer cases | 12, 265 to 611 ms each | 36, 71 to 223 ms each |

The slowest three-officer case drops from 611 ms to 223 ms (×0.36). Applied to the worst CI reading on the card (5534 ms on #35386's loaded shard), that is about 2.0 s, which leaves 2.5× headroom under the 5 s default.

<details><summary>vitest verdict lines</summary>

```text
before:  Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  104 passed (104)   Duration  30.67s (tests 20.94s)
after:   Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  128 passed (128)   Duration  32.81s (tests 22.27s)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 (both runs)
typecheck (@objectstack/plugin-security, tsc + scripts + check:test-typecheck): VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

### Acceptance notes
- Mechanism reading: the repo's declared-budget shape is the one-line file header `test-budget: SECONDS — CLASS: REASON`, which `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` (`readTestBudget`) reads. It governs the timings report's 10 s per-FILE wall line, not vitest's per-case timeout, and this file already carries one (20 s). It cannot hold a single case under 5 s, so splitting is the route.
- The card reports the whole file at 75 to 179 s on loaded CI shards, against its declared 20 s budget. That was not re-measured here; it is left for the timings refresh lane.
- Three other cases in the same file (the per-posture hidden-column cases) run about 0.56 to 0.64 s locally, the same order as the old three-officer cases. None is reported timing out, and they are untouched.

### Verification
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 54 commands for this diff. 52 exit 0. 2 exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` need a full workspace build); they are recorded NOT MEASURED and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 54 accounted, 52 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `skip-changeset`: this is a test-only diff, so nothing is published.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed. The assertions are byte-identical; only their grouping into cases moved.
